summary: Loads MPCDI calibration data for projection workflows and exposes projection and camera transform members for use with Camera COMP setups.

key_params.name: near
key_params.note: Near plane value used for projection data

key_params.name: far
key_params.note: Far plane value used for projection data

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Requires a valid .mpcdi calibration file; the DAT does not generate calibration from geometry.
Projection values normally need to be applied through MPCDI DAT Python members on a Camera COMP.
Buffer and region identifiers must match the calibration file or the desired region will not be selected.
Near and far settings affect projection data and should match the render camera's intended clipping range.
key_concepts: Reads MPCDI calibration files and outputs buffer or region metadata.
Output By, Buffer ID, and Region ID choose which file section is extracted.
Near and Far parameters provide projection-depth context for calibration data.
Reload Pulse refreshes the parsed MPCDI file after path or file changes.
